actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 402 - 0 (Roll no. 241). (text: CR H3877-3878)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 402 - 0 (Roll no. 241). (text: CR H3877-3878)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3881-3882)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 3425.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3877-3879)
Mr. Barrett moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 196.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts contract security personnel, security contractors, and federal building tenants.
dimensions.evidence: performance testing and improvement protocols for contract security personnel

dimensions.assessment: Changes training, oversight, and shift tracking for security personnel, requiring corrective plans for test failures.
dimensions.evidence: mandatory, cause-specific corrective training and performance improvement plan for any individual who fails a covert test

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific appropriations or financial expenditures.
Directs specific operational protocols, reporting requirements, and tracking system evaluations for the Federal Protective Service.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Federal Protective Service (FPS) to improve the performance of security personnel contracted to protect federal buildings

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual reporting requirements and permanent operational protocols.

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for replacing or upgrading the personnel tracking system.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates the Federal Protective Service to establish data collection, covert testing performance protocols, corrective training plans, and personnel tracking evaluations for contract security personnel protecting federal buildings.
